column1: Alejandro Kirk stands out as the top pick, hitting third on the road with a strong track record of consistency and a favorable platoon edge against Brady Basso. Kirk’s steady contact skills and a slight park boost add to his reliability in this matchup. Yandy Diaz also offers a high floor, leading off and showing excellent recent form, though he faces a tougher pitcher. Jeremy Pena and Jonathan Aranda are viable alternatives, but Kirk’s combination of lineup spot and matchup gives him the edge.
